0.original: Alphinaud is determined to offer the villagers what succor he can.

48.original: His wounds are deep, but he may yet be saved. I will see to him─pray look after the others!

49.original: When I last came here to sell my fish, everyone was so bright and cheerful. This is a nightmare...

50.original: The horror... I pray that the Sisters will see us through this calamity...

51.original: There is nothing you can do for this villager.

52.original: This villager has been dead for some time.

53.original: I...I am fine, thank you... Please...save the others...

54.original: This poor soul is beyond saving.

55.original: I can tend to the rest. Pray look after Matsya─no doubt what we have seen here weighs even heavier on his heart than ours.

56.original: Stay by Matsya's side, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Unlike us, he is not accustomed to seeing such horrors...

58.original: This is Yeruvvet, the elder here. He is hurt, but─praise be to the Sisters─he still lives!

59.original: Young Matsya here has told me everything. I have not the words to express my gratitude for your aid.

60.original: When the heavens began to burn, we were afraid, but did our best to carry on as we always have done...

61.original: Until today, when those unholy beasts came pouring into our village, a flood of midnight and death...

62.original: There are no words to describe what followed. Men and women I have known since they were babes struck down by the creatures, only to rise again to join the murderous horde, in the guise of those same hideous fiends...

63.original: In the chaos, a handful of our villagers fled for their lives. I can only hope they have found their way to safety...

64.original: Matsya, do you perchance remember Qerasaf and Mehvan? The young couple who always bought your freshest catches...

65.original: How could I forget, Elder? When I first came to peddle my wares─desperate to eke out a living─they showed me such kindness...

66.original: Others shunned me as an outsider, as is their way. But Qerasaf and Mehvan bought my fish, and sung its praises. They turned my fortunes around!

67.original: Alas, I fear they are in terrible danger. I saw them running towards Agama Temple, one of those beasts in close pursuit.

68.original: They had their child─still but a tiny babe. To elude these fiends while caring for one so young is an impossible task, surely. I beg of you, go to their aid...

69.original: I...I want to help them. Yet I am but a fisherman─I cannot face beasts on my own. Will you come with me?

70.original: Oh, thank you! Agama Temple lies to the west of here. We must hurry!

71.original: Don't worry─Alphinaud and I will watch over the village until you return. Go and find Matsya's friends.

73.original: It was built by those who worship Saint Agama, but has sadly fallen into disrepair in recent years.

74.original: If my friends made it this far, no doubt they are hiding somewhere amidst the ruins.

76.original: That was Qerasaf! Oh, no─this is not good!

80.original: P-Please do! The cry came from the ruins. You must hurry!

81.original: Y-Yes, I understand... The cry came from the ruins! You must hurry!

82.original: That was Qerasaf's voice─I'm sure of it! Oh gods...gods have mercy...

85.original: The man lies motionless on the ground, bearing a grievous wound...

86.original: I'm sorry, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I tried to stay behind, but I couldn't...

89.original: My arms...so heavy... And my legs... I cannot feel my legs...

91.original: I need to find them...need to be with them...

93.original: Qerasaf! No, Qerasaf─you must stay strong!

94.original: More time... I thought I had...

101.original: Mehvan still lives. And she has their child...

102.original: We must search the jungle between here and Palaka's Stand. There is nowhere else she could have gone. I think...

103.original: Forgive me, Qerasaf... Once we have saved your wife and child, we will return and lay you to rest...

104.original: You see no tracks or other signs of recent travel. Mehvan and the child must be elsewhere...

107.original: If Mehvan and her daughter came through this area recently, you see no evidence of their passage...

108.original: ...There. Your wounds have closed. Can you stand?

109.original: Just a moment, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'll be with you shortly.

110.original: D-Did you see any sign of them? I found nothing!

111.original: Perhaps the beasts have chased them farther from the village.

112.original: Oh, gods above, I beseech you! Pray deliver Mehvan and her little one to safety...
